# DeepSeek
> DeepSeek is an AI research company building open and API-accessible large language models for chat, reasoning, and coding.

DeepSeek develops frontier foundation models and provides consumer chat products, developer APIs, model documentation, pricing, status, and research resources. Its ecosystem spans web chat, API integration, open-source model releases, and technical documentation.

## Main Site
- [DeepSeek Homepage](https://deepseek.com): Main product homepage introducing DeepSeek models, chat, and API access.
- [English Homepage](https://deepseek.com/en): English-language homepage for DeepSeek products, models, and platform overview.
- [DeepSeek Chat](https://chat.deepseek.com): Web chat application for interacting with DeepSeek models directly.
- [Platform](https://platform.deepseek.com): Developer platform for API keys, usage, billing, and model access.

## API Documentation
- [API Docs Home](https://api-docs.deepseek.com): Main documentation portal for DeepSeek API integration and developer resources.
- [Quick Start](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/introduction): Introduction to the DeepSeek API, authentication, and first requests.
- [Authentication](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/authentication): How to create API keys and authenticate requests to DeepSeek services.
- [Rate Limits](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/rate_limit): Request rate limits and throughput constraints for API usage.
- [Error Codes](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/error_codes): Reference for API error responses and troubleshooting common failures.
- [Models & Pricing](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing): Supported models, token pricing, and cost comparison information.
- [News](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/news/news250120): Product and API update announcements published in the docs portal.

## API Reference
- [Chat Completion](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/create-chat-completion): Reference for creating chat completions with DeepSeek models.
- [List Models](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/list-models): Endpoint reference for listing available models on the platform.
- [Function Calling](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/function_calling): Guide to tool and function calling with chat models.
- [JSON Output](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/json_mode): Structured JSON generation and response formatting guidance.
- [Context Caching](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/context_caching): How to reuse cached context to reduce latency and cost.
- [Prefix Completion](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/prefix_completion): Guide for prefix-based completion workflows and supported behavior.
- [FIM Completion](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/fim_completion): Fill-in-the-middle completion guide for code and editing scenarios.

## Integration Guides
- [Streaming](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/streaming): How to receive streaming responses from DeepSeek API endpoints.
- [Reasoning Model](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/reasoning_model): Usage guidance for reasoning-capable DeepSeek models and response behavior.
- [Chat Prefix Completion Beta](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/chat_prefix_completion): Beta guide for chat prefix completion workflows.
- [Multi-round Conversation](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/multi_round_chat): Best practices for maintaining context across multi-turn conversations.
- [Token Usage](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/token_usage): How token counting and usage accounting work in DeepSeek API.
- [OpenAI SDK Compatibility](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/): Documentation for using DeepSeek through OpenAI-compatible client patterns.

## Models
- [DeepSeek-V3](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/news/news1226): Announcement and usage notes for the DeepSeek-V3 model release.
- [DeepSeek-R1](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/news/news250120): Announcement and documentation updates for DeepSeek-R1.
- [DeepSeek-V2.5](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/news/news0925): Release update for DeepSeek-V2.5 capabilities and availability.
- [DeepSeek-Coder-V2](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/news/news0716): Release announcement for DeepSeek-Coder-V2 and related API support.
- [DeepSeek-V2](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/news/news0628): Release update for DeepSeek-V2 model availability and platform changes.
- [DeepSeek Reasoner](https://platform.deepseek.com): Reasoning-oriented model access through the DeepSeek developer platform.
- [DeepSeek Chat Model](https://platform.deepseek.com): General-purpose chat model access through the DeepSeek platform console.

## Developer Platform
- [Platform Console](https://platform.deepseek.com): Central console for managing API access, usage, and account settings.
- [API Keys](https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys): Create and manage API keys for DeepSeek integrations.
- [Usage](https://platform.deepseek.com/usage): Monitor token consumption and API usage metrics.
- [Billing](https://platform.deepseek.com/top_up): Add credits and manage payment for API consumption.
- [Docs](https://platform.deepseek.com/docs): Entry point from the platform to DeepSeek developer documentation.
- [Download App](https://platform.deepseek.com/downloads/app): Download DeepSeek applications from the developer platform.

## Status and Operations

- [API Status](https://status.deepseek.com): Availability monitoring for API endpoints and platform services.
- [Web Chat Status](https://status.deepseek.com): Operational visibility for DeepSeek chat and related web services.
